name: claude-code-mods
description: Two mods for Claude Code: a per-session usage cap (/budget) and a prompt-cache keep-alive (/keepalive)

plugins.name: session-budget
plugins.description: Cap how much of the account's 5h / weekly usage one session may use; soft-stops the session at the cap

plugins.name: cache-keepalive
plugins.description: Keep the prompt cache warm while away: /keepalive N pings every ~50 min, at most N times
